Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :s_product_type is not null then
 begin
 select product_type_desc into :s_product_desc from valid_product_types
 where product_type_code =:s_product_type and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1245');-- invalid product type
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then null;
 when others then handle_error;check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;
